injuries.t: LeBron James OUT (low back/sciatica), downgraded from questionable. Embiid likely sits one game of back-to-back. Barlow, Fall, Hukporti out; Wade Q.
Saka, Saliba, Tzolis out
Grealish (ill), Branthwaite (concussion protocol) out
Pep Chavarria out; Malo Gusto returns
QB M. Heintschel listed out-for-season
vs Michigan State: MSU QBs Alessio Milivojevic and Cam Fancher out, true freshman Kayd Coffman to start; UCLA also starting backup QB Ty Dieffenbach. UCLA leg kept but recheck line before kickoff.
Koundé (ankle) and Dani Olmo (adductor) out for El Clásico; Eric García and Christensen also out.
Storm Austen (80mph winds) puts Man United vs Bournemouth and Liverpool vs Brighton at risk of postponement; recheck before betting.
Lamar Jackson questionable (high ankle) for Sunday vs Bengals.
Curry out (rest, back-to-back), Podziemski out (back); Draymond Green doubtful.
Malkin out (illness); Girard to IR; Chinakhov out. Silovs starts.
Levi on IR; Jarry starts vs Toronto; Ekholm out 3 games.
Yves Missi out (knee).
Jalen Duren OUT (hamstring) Sunday at 76ers; Ausar Thompson questionable (ankle).
Paolo Banchero out 4-6 weeks (high ankle sprain).
Knueppel, Coby White, Boswell, Grant Williams out vs Heat (2nd of back-to-back).
DeVonta Smith, Nolan Smith, Wicks out Monday vs Cowboys; Barkley questionable.
S Jevon Holland (concussion) and TE Theo Johnson (neck) downgraded to OUT at Texans; Greg Newsome II out; Tremaine Edmunds to IR.
Bulls C Nic Claxton out (hamstring); Wizards rookie AJ Dybantsa out (ankle), third straight game.
Cameron Johnson, Spencer Jones, Strawther out; Alpha Diallo questionable vs Pelicans.
Mouhamed Gueye - Out: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Henri Veesaar - Out: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Tyler Bilodeau - Out: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.
Grant Williams - Out: Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.
Coby White - Out: White (calf) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Miami.
Kon Knueppel - Out: Knueppel (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.
Kylan Boswell - Out: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.
Patrick Williams - Out: Williams (groin) is out for Saturday's game versus the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
Noa Essengue - Out: Essengue (head) won't suit up for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
Nic Claxton - Out: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
Kyrie Irving - Out: Irving is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs due to rest, Christian Clark of The Athletic reports.
Caleb Martin - Out: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out against San Antonio on Saturday.
Tarik Biberovic - Out: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against San Antonio.
Santi Aldama - Out: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

Cooper Flagg - Out: The Mavericks diagnosed Flagg with a mild left shoulder sprain, and the second-year forward will be re-evaluated by medical staff next week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Dereck Lively II - Out: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.
Alpha Diallo - Out: Diallo (wrist) won't play Saturday against the Pelicans.
Cameron Johnson - Out: Head coach David Aldeman said that Johnson is "day-to-day" due to his sprained right ankle, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
Spencer Jones - Out: Jones (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pelicans.
Julian Strawther - Out: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
Draymond Green - Out: Green (back) won't play Saturday in Phoenix.
Al Horford - Out: Horford (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Suns.
Stephen Curry - Out: Curry (rest) won't play Saturday against the Suns.

Brandin Podziemski - Out: Podziemski (back) told reporters Friday that he will not play in the second leg of the Warriors' back-to-back set Saturday against the Suns, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

Kristaps Porzingis - Out: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Moses Moody - Out: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jimmy Butler III - Out: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Marcus Smart - Out: Smart (forearm) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.
Steven Adams - Out: Adams (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
Fred VanVleet - Out: VanVleet (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
Yves Missi - Out: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Jabari Walker - Day-To-Day: Walker exited to the locker room in the third quarter of Saturday's game against the Bucks due to an apparent ankle injury, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
LeBron James - Out: James (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Tacko Fall - Out: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
Dominick Barlow - Out: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Ariel Hukporti - Out: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Oso Ighodaro - Out: Ighodaro (oblique) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
Mark Williams - Out: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Tobias Harris - Out: Harris (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.
Jayden Quaintance - Out: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
AJ Dybantsa - Out: Dybantsa (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bulls.
Tristan Vukcevic - Out: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Jamir Watkins - Out: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
Pavel Mintyukov - Injured Reserve: Mintyukov (lower body) was put on injured reserve Thursday.
Ian Moore - Injured Reserve: Head coach Joel Quenneville said Friday that Moore (lower body) is still "a ways from skating," Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports.
Ryan Poehling - Injured Reserve: Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.
Troy Terry - Injured Reserve: Terry (hip) was moved from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports.
Justin Danforth - Out: out
Jiri Kulich - Out: Kulich (face) is back in Buffalo for evaluation and won't play against Washington on Saturday, according to Paul Hamilton of WGR Sports Radio 550.
Sam Carrick - Injured Reserve: ir
Alex Lyon - Injured Reserve: Lyon (upper body) had a setback in his recovery and is without a timeline to return, the team announced Thursday.
Matt Grzelcyk - Injured Reserve: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.
Conor Timmins - Injured Reserve: Timmins (lower body) doesn't have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com on Tuesday.
Jack Rathbone - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Mikael Backlund - Out: out
Jonathan Huberdeau - Injured Reserve: Huberdeau (hip) skated with his teammates Saturday, but he isn't close to returning, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.
Samuel Honzek - Injured Reserve: ir
Mark Jankowski - Out: out
Taylor Hall - Injured Reserve: ir
Jordan Staal - Injured Reserve: ir
Alexander Nikishin - Injured Reserve: Nikishin (contract dispute) is on the Hurricanes' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.
Daniil Tarasov - Day-To-Day: day-to-day
